title: NatureFlex product specification / declaration 01505
scope: NVS45 articles including 22249, material/cost analogue only
findings: 22249 is 210 mm x 500 m, 45 micrometre coated regenerated cellulose; coatings fall under EU 10/2011. Hot-fill entries: 70 C/120 min, 80 C/60 min, 90 C/30 min, 100 C/15 min. Remove film before heating. German/French note advises against monoweb storage over 15 min above 70 C; English repeats low-temperature note.
limitations: Not accepted as BIOPAP six-hour film or Gaia liner. Food-contact entries and physical caution must be read together; no six-hour approval. No coating mass.
geographical_relevance: International technical/commercial analogue; transfer limited to stated scope
